title: Setup asks whether the kb server lists the coord tools, and kb_mcp.py --register-local --coord-tools on|off records the choice
goal: kb_mcp.py --register-local takes --coord-tools on|off (on by default): off registers the kb server with KB_COORD_TOOLS=0 in its env, on with no such variable; the kb-setup skill's MCP step asks with AskUserQuestion whether to list the coord tools (on recommended, naming their always-on context cost for clients that load every tool schema) and runs the registration with the answer; plugin.md and tools.md say how to change the choice later; plugin.md and the alternatives doc no longer say the coord tools need KB_COORD_TOOLS=1 or that dedup matches by meaning

run:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,shutil
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();out={}
try:
    for v in ('on','off'):
        r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kb_mcp.py','--register-local','--coord-tools',v,'--project',d,'--dry-run'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
        kb=[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('kb:')]
        out[v]=(r.returncode,kb[0] if kb else '')
        print(v,r.returncode,(kb[0] if kb else r.stderr.strip()[-200:])[:300])
finally: shutil.rmtree(d,ignore_errors=True)
ok=out['on'][0]==0 and out['off'][0]==0 and 'KB_COORD_TOOLS' not in out['on'][1] and '"KB_COORD_TOOLS": "0"' in out['off'][1]
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import re,sys
t=open('.claude/skills/kb-setup/SKILL.md').read();s=t[t.index('## 4. MCP servers'):];s=s[:s.index('
## ',5)]
ok='--coord-tools' in s and 'KB_COORD_TOOLS' in s and 'AskUserQuestion' in s
print('step 4 asks coord tools:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
import sys;ok=all('--coord-tools' in open(p).read() for p in ('kb/_self/plugin.md','kb/_self/tools.md'));print('docs name --coord-tools:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
import sys,re;t=open('kb/_self/plugin.md').read()+open('kb/_self/alternatives.md').read();b=[p for p in ('KB_COORD_TOOLS=1','by meaning') if p in t];print(b);sys.exit(1 if b else 0)
